Pay the fine. It’s trivial relative to my cash, and leaving jail now preserves my ability to land, trade, and pressure the board immediately. I want to re-enter the game with initiative rather than gamble on doubles and potentially waste turns while opponents consolidate.

Buy immediately. Orange is one of the strongest groups, and St. James pairs directly with Gemini’s Tennessee to create real future leverage. Hold firm. Marvin is worth far more than 100 and I don’t need to liquidate it cheaply. Grok has plenty of cash and may still pay a serious premium if I keep the floor high. $500 preserves strong value if he accepts, while signaling that lowballing won’t move me.

Boardwalk alone is worth a disciplined premium because it is a late-game premium property and a set-completion threat if Park Place later appears in a trade or auction. I want to keep pressure on Grok and force him to pay more if he insists on the prestige buy.
